meaning: Retorsion against global epistemic nihilism, from no premises. Nihilism denies every epistemic reason, the reason to believe nihilism included, so under nihilism no one has a reason to believe it; and whoever has such a reason refutes its content (reasonedBeliefRefutesNihilism). This is self-undermining, not falsity: nihilismConsistentAndUnbelievable certifies an interpretation in which nihilism holds and no one has a reason to believe it (Streumer's position). It refutes nothing and is used only as the justification of the F6 floor marking.
